## Summary

I implemented support for field extraction on dictionary-encoded struct columns in Apache DataFusion. All changes are in source files (no `tests/` directory files touched).

### 1. `datafusion/functions/src/core/getfield.rs`

**`return_field_from_args` (type inference)** — Added a match arm for `DataType::Dictionary(key_type, value_type)` when the value type is a `Struct`. It looks up the requested field within the struct definition and returns `Dictionary(key_type, field_type)`, preserving the dictionary encoding (e.g. `Dictionary(UInt32, Struct{name: Utf8})['name']` → `Dictionary(UInt32, Utf8)`). A missing field name produces a plan error, and nullability is propagated.

**`extract_single_field` (execution)** — Added arms for dictionary-of-struct base arrays. It uses `AsArray::as_any_dictionary()` to get the struct values array, extracts the named field column, and rewraps it via `with_values()` so the output keeps the original keys. Because the keys (including their null buffer) are preserved, a NULL key row yields NULL for any field. A non-existent field yields an exec error; a non-string index yields a clear error. Added `AsArray` to the imports.

### 2. `datafusion/sqllogictest/src/test_context.rs`

Added `register_dictionary_struct_table`, registering:
- **`dict_struct_table`** — `dict_struct: Dictionary(UInt32, Struct{name, id})` built from keys `[0,1,2,0,1]` into a 3-entry values array, plus an equivalent plain `plain_struct` column with the same 5 logical rows.
- **`dict_struct_nullable`** — `ds` with keys `[0, NULL, 1, NULL]` (logical rows `{X,10}, NULL, {Y,20}, NULL`).

Also wired the `"dictionary_struct.slt"` dispatch arm and added the necessary array/datatype imports.

### 3. `datafusion/sqllogictest/test_files/dictionary_struct.slt`

New test file covering: output type verification via `arrow_typeof` (both bracket and `get_field()` forms), value equivalence against the plain struct column, filtering, `GROUP BY` aggregation, `ORDER BY`, NULL propagation on absent keys, and error on a non-existent field.
